title: Local native bootstrap client original capture with installation v2
description: Public local capture, not an authenticated receipt or issuance/installation authority. The producing client emits one UTF-8 JSON line including exactly one final LF, at most 1572864 bytes. Exact bootstrap evidence is retained alongside the local installation diagnostic for later packet extraction without a second bootstrap attempt. Keep actual producer exit status separately; a valid shape cannot prove successful acquisition or installation. Explicit v2 only; v1 remains closed to the installation member.
